---
title: "PDF preparation"
format: html
---



```{r}
library(googledrive)
library(tidyverse)
library(glue)
source("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/forrtproject/FReD-data/refs/heads/main/clean_cos_fred.R")


ds_fully_raw <- read_csv("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vR_62H8liC0P3-WQ1xx4UalDnvqzPfObWBFwQAgVH6JhF3dPBFXd7AgFK_OljxFWQkNtUYdnUbuFTpe/pub?output=csv", skip = 1)

cleaned <- clean_fred_data(ds_fully_raw)

ds_raw <- cleaned$cleaned_data

# filter empty rows
ds_raw <- ds_raw %>% filter(!is.na(ref_o), !is.na(ref_r))

# ID to distinguish replications where multiple are in same paper
ds_raw$id_r <- coalesce(ds_raw$url_r, ds_raw$doi_r)

# filter out excluded studies
ds_raw <- ds_raw[is.na(ds_raw$exclusion), ]


# Number of coded but not validated entries
ds_awaitingvalidation <- ds_raw[ds_raw$status %in% c("awaiting validation", "validated - chosen (external)"), ]

# filter for validated - chosen entries
# changed this as base-R subsetting struggles with NAs
ds <- ds_raw %>% filter(status == "validated - chosen")



# Deauthenticate (useful for public folders)
drive_deauth()

# Replace with your actual folder ID
folder_id <- "1VMbkD0_rORNE9MH_0aO_yywfZ-y5_ir1"

# List files in the folder
files <- drive_ls(as_id(folder_id))
print(files)


files_found <- union(intersect(ds$file_o, files$name),
                     intersect(ds$file_r, files$name))

files_missing <- union(setdiff(ds$file_o, files$name),
                     setdiff(ds$file_r, files$name))

files_case_issue <- setdiff(files_missing,
                            union(setdiff(tolower(ds$file_o), tolower(files$name)),
                                  setdiff(tolower(ds$file_r), tolower(files$name))))
                              
files_missing <- setdiff(files_missing, files_case_issue)

drive_auth() 

# Copy relevant files into shareable folder

dest_id <- as_id("10GSKukVmMe9SmzcDvATxTjm_VqMyDqc5")

relevant_files <- files %>% filter(name %in% files_found)

copied <- map(relevant_files$id, ~ drive_cp(as_id(.x), path = dest_id), .progress = TRUE)

map2(
  copied,
  relevant_files$name,
  ~ drive_rename(.x, .y)
)

intersect(list.files("/Users/lukaswallrich/Downloads/pdf_downloads"), files_missing)

file.rename(list.files("/Users/lukaswallrich/Downloads/pdf_downloads", full.names = TRUE),
            file.path("/Users/lukaswallrich/Downloads/pdf_downloads",
                      tolower(basename(list.files("/Users/lukaswallrich/Downloads/pdf_downloads")))))



replace_na_filename <- function(filename) {
  filename %>% 
    na_if(".pdf") %>% 
    na_if("na.pdf") %>% 
    na_if("NA - USE URL")
}

files_missing <- replace_na_filename(files_missing) %>% unique()

files_missing <- setdiff(files_missing, list.files("/Users/lukaswallrich/Downloads/pdf_downloads/found"))

# Move the relevant files into a "found" subdirectory
files_moved <- file.rename(from = file.path("/Users/lukaswallrich/Downloads/pdf_downloads", intersect(list.files("/Users/lukaswallrich/Downloads/pdf_downloads"), files_missing)),
                            to = file.path("/Users/lukaswallrich/Downloads/pdf_downloads/found",
                                           intersect(list.files("/Users/lukaswallrich/Downloads/pdf_downloads"), files_missing)))


probs <- ds %>% select(file = file_o, doi = doi_o) %>% 
  bind_rows(ds %>% select(file = file_r, doi = doi_r)) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(file %in% files_missing)

probs %>% 
  pull(doi) %>% 
  str_subset("^10\\.") %>% clipr::write_clip()


```

```{r}
#| echo: false
2 * 2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).
